---
title: "A complete hooks file"
---

Hooks rarely live alone. A real `.claude/hooks/` directory mixes a safety block and a workflow gate. This capstone shows two primitives composing in one file, and which one carries inline tests.

<!-- gd-embed: capstone.py -->

`block_command` is deterministic, so it ships with inline tests. Drop the file into `.claude/hooks/` and `uvx capt-hook test` runs them. The `gate` fires on live session state, like which files were touched and whether the tests ran; verify it by replaying a real session, or give it inline tests with a `transcript` fixture. One file listens on `PreToolUse`, `Stop`, and `SubagentStop` at once. See [Test hooks inline](../guide/testing.qmd) and [Enforce a multi-step workflow](../guide/workflows.qmd).
